title: A shift-symmetric temporal current unifies the dark background

statements.text: Near a stable kinetic minimum, one shift-symmetric temporal current splits on the homogeneous background into a vacuum-like term and a dust-like term scaling as $a^{-3}$, a background unification of dark energy and dark matter behavior. It does not by itself derive galactic halos, lensing or cluster dynamics.
statements.conditions: graded by the author as a background result with halos, lensing and cluster dynamics left open

standing.reason: The author grades the background result as closed and the halo, lensing and cluster sectors as open. No test has decided it.

sources.quote: This gives a controlled background unification of dark energy and dark matter behaviour. It does not, by itself, derive galactic haloes.
